title: Swallowed Interruption Signals
pattern: Catching a thread interruption signal and failing to propagate it or re-assert the thread's interrupt status.
why_bad: Discards cancellation requests. Prevents parent threads or executors from safely terminating the thread.
detection: Catching thread interruption exceptions without re-throwing them or calling `Thread.currentThread().interrupt()`.
counterexample: None. Interruption signals must never be blindly ignored.
fix: Re-set the thread's interrupt flag or propagate the error.
source: Maurice Herlihy, *Monitors and Blocking Synchronization*, Chapter 8.
